list.name: sites
list.label: Sucursales
list.query: SELECT store_name AS __text, store_id AS __value FROM sites WHERE status = 'operational' ORDER BY store_name

panels.title: Tráfico por sucursal y día del mes
panels.description: Matriz: filas = sucursal, columnas = día del mes (01-31), valor = visitantes.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.store_name AS "Sucursal",
         SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(day FROM c.bucket_day)=1) AS "01",
         SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(day FROM c.bucket_day)=2) AS "02",
         SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(day FROM c.bucket_day)=3) AS "03",
         SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(day FROM c.bucket_day)=4) AS "04",
         SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(day FROM c.bucket_day)=5) AS "05",
         SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(day FROM c.bucket_day)=6) AS "06",
         SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(day FROM c.bucket_day)=7) AS "07",
         SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(day FROM c.bucket_day)=8) AS "08",
         SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(day FROM c.bucket_day)=9) AS "09",
         SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(day FROM c.bucket_day)=10) AS "10",
         SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(day FROM c.bucket_day)=11) AS "11",
         SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(day FROM c.bucket_day)=12) AS "12",
         SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(day FROM c.bucket_day)=13) AS "13",
         SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(day FROM c.bucket_day)=14) AS "14",
         SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(day FROM c.bucket_day)=15) AS "15",
         SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(day FROM c.bucket_day)=16) AS "16",
         SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(day FROM c.bucket_day)=17) AS "17",
         SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(day FROM c.bucket_day)=18) AS "18",
         SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(day FROM c.bucket_day)=19) AS "19",
         SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(day FROM c.bucket_day)=20) AS "20",
         SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(day FROM c.bucket_day)=21) AS "21",
         SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(day FROM c.bucket_day)=22) AS "22",
         SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(day FROM c.bucket_day)=23) AS "23",
         SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(day FROM c.bucket_day)=24) AS "24",
         SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(day FROM c.bucket_day)=25) AS "25",
         SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(day FROM c.bucket_day)=26) AS "26",
         SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(day FROM c.bucket_day)=27) AS "27",
         SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(day FROM c.bucket_day)=28) AS "28",
         SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(day FROM c.bucket_day)=29) AS "29",
         SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(day FROM c.bucket_day)=30) AS "30",
         SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(day FROM c.bucket_day)=31) AS "31",
         SUM(c.ins) AS "Total"
  FROM counting_by_bucket_day c JOIN sites s USING (store_id)
  WHERE c.store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND c.bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date
  GROUP BY s.store_name ORDER BY "Total" DESC

panels.title: Visitantes por día de la semana × hora
panels.description: Visitantes por día de la semana (filas) y hora del día (columnas), promediados sobre el rango seleccionado (con 7 días = el valor de cada día; con rangos más largos = el patrón típico). Celdas coloreadas por intensidad.

targets.rawSql: WITH d AS (SELECT (bucket_hour AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS dd, extract(isodow FROM bucket_hour AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int AS dow, extract(hour FROM bucket_hour AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int AS hr, SUM(ins) AS tot FROM counting_by_bucket_hour WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_hour BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) SELECT CASE dow WHEN 1 THEN 'Lun' WHEN 2 THEN 'Mar' WHEN 3 THEN 'Mié' WHEN 4 THEN 'Jue' WHEN 5 THEN 'Vie' WHEN 6 THEN 'Sáb' WHEN 7 THEN 'Dom' END AS "Día", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=0)),0) AS "00:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=1)),0) AS "01:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=2)),0) AS "02:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=3)),0) AS "03:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=4)),0) AS "04:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=5)),0) AS "05:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=6)),0) AS "06:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=7)),0) AS "07:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=8)),0) AS "08:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=9)),0) AS "09:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=10)),0) AS "10:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=11)),0) AS "11:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=12)),0) AS "12:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=13)),0) AS "13:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=14)),0) AS "14:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=15)),0) AS "15:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=16)),0) AS "16:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=17)),0) AS "17:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=18)),0) AS "18:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=19)),0) AS "19:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=20)),0) AS "20:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=21)),0) AS "21:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=22)),0) AS "22:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=23)),0) AS "23:00" FROM d GROUP BY dow ORDER BY dow

panels.title: Tráfico por hora según día de la semana
panels.description: Perfil horario (00-23) del tráfico promedio, una línea por día de la semana, agregado de las sucursales seleccionadas.

targets.rawSql: SELECT g AS "Hora", round(AVG(h.ins) FILTER (WHERE h.dow=1),1) AS "Lunes", round(AVG(h.ins) FILTER (WHERE h.dow=2),1) AS "Martes", round(AVG(h.ins) FILTER (WHERE h.dow=3),1) AS "Miércoles", round(AVG(h.ins) FILTER (WHERE h.dow=4),1) AS "Jueves", round(AVG(h.ins) FILTER (WHERE h.dow=5),1) AS "Viernes", round(AVG(h.ins) FILTER (WHERE h.dow=6),1) AS "Sábado", round(AVG(h.ins) FILTER (WHERE h.dow=7),1) AS "Domingo" FROM generate_series(0,23) g LEFT JOIN ( SELECT extract(hour FROM bucket_hour AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int hr, extract(isodow FROM (bucket_hour AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))::int dow, ins FROM counting_by_bucket_hour WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_hour BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) h ON h.hr=g GROUP BY g ORDER BY g

panels.title: Dispositivos únicos por día (WiFi/BLE)
panels.description: Cantidad de dispositivos distintos detectados por día tras stitching local del device (un dispositivo con N rotaciones de MAC cuenta como 1).

targets.rawSql: SELECT (bucket_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires') AS time, SUM(visitors) AS "Dispositivos únicos" FROM wifi_ble_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Repetición intra-día (engagement)
panels.description: Distribución de dispositivos según cuántas ventanas de 15 min los observaron. 1 ventana = pasaron rápido; 3+ ventanas = rondaron o se quedaron cerca — proxy de engagement.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE windows_bucket WHEN '1' THEN '1 ventana' WHEN '2' THEN '2 ventanas' WHEN '3-5' THEN '3-5 ventanas' ELSE '6+ ventanas' END AS "Ventanas", SUM(visitors) AS "Dispositivos" FROM wifi_engagement_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY windows_bucket ORDER BY MIN(CASE windows_bucket WHEN '1' THEN 1 WHEN '2' THEN 2 WHEN '3-5' THEN 3 ELSE 6 END)

panels.title: Composición demográfica de los visitantes
panels.description: Distribución de los visitantes por categoría etaria estimada (altura medida por estéreo). Métrica anecdótica/de contexto, no accionable por la operación.

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(ins_adult) AS "Adultos", SUM(ins_child) AS "Niños" FROM counting_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date

panels.title: Duración promedio de visita por día
panels.description: Permanencia promedio estimada por la Ley de Little (ocupación ÷ arribos), del total seleccionado, por día. Métrica de contexto/experiencia.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_day AS time, SUM(visit_duration_minutes*arrivals)/NULLIF(SUM(arrivals),0) AS "Duración (min)" FROM visit_duration_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

target.rawSql: SELECT (holiday_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires') AS time, name AS text FROM holidays WHERE holiday_date BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date ORDER BY holiday_date
